_readme: Court-documented land-change events used as ground-truth validation cases. Each AOI is a 2.56 km square at 10 m. T0 and T1 use the same weeks of the year to limit seasonal change. Coordinates come from public sources and are approximate; the change is checked in the data itself before any claim is made.

aois.name: Khori Gaon, Faridabad
aois.event: Supreme Court-ordered demolition of informal structures on Aravalli land protected under the Punjab Land Preservation Act, mid-2021.
aois.expected_change: Built-up structures removed (demolition), surface turns to rubble and bare earth
aois.citation: Supreme Court of India, Municipal Corporation of Faridabad v. Khori Gaon Residents Welfare Association, SLP (C) 7220-7221/2017, orders of 2021

aois.name: Kot / Dhauj, Faridabad Aravallis
aois.event: Reported illegal stone quarrying in the Aravalli hills despite the mining ban, 2021-2024.
aois.expected_change: Vegetation loss and new bare rock / soil (mining)
aois.citation: NGT OA 362/2022 (Aravalli Bachao Citizens Movement v. Union of India), as reported; unverified

aois.name: Yamuna floodplain (Zone O), Delhi
aois.event: DDA clearance of encroachments (nurseries, structures, farms) on about 401 ha of Yamuna floodplain, 2023-2024.
aois.expected_change: Encroachments cleared: nurseries / farms / structures removed
aois.citation: Times of India, '401.4 hectares of floodplain freed from squatters on Yamuna riverbed', July 2024; NGT proceedings
